Quests.Title: Lyra: the missing pattern
Quests.Description: Speak with Lyra in Worldbound Stories.|Choose how you want to restore the atelier.

Quests.Title: Lyra: a thread across the sea
Quests.Description: Explore Tidepool Hollows with a Tide Compass.|The old tide shrine may hold her lost pattern.

Quests.Title: Lyra: a garden of our own
Quests.Description: Bring 6 Pale Blooms from the Citadel.|A new beginning deserves a place to grow.

Quests.Title: Lyra: a life of my own
Quests.Description: Return to Worldbound Stories for Lyra's next chapter.|Your support belongs in the finished collection.

Quests.Title: The archive: a missing name
Quests.Description: Speak to the archive echo in Worldbound Stories.|The Bellkeeper was not the end of the silence.

Quests.Title: The archive: what remained
Quests.Description: Find the Archive Caretaker in the Hush.|Its pages hold fragments of the missing explorers.

Quests.Title: The archive: write it back
Quests.Description: Defeat The Unwritten in the Hush after Plantera.|Move out of its marked charge and violet volleys.

Quests.Title: Mira: somewhere gentle
Quests.Description: Speak to Mira in Worldbound Stories.|Her memorial garden starts with a small promise.

Quests.Title: Mira: a light for the path
Quests.Description: Bring a Garden Lantern for Mira's remembrance walk.|Craft one from Glass and Wood at a Work Bench.

Quests.Title: The last gardener
Quests.Description: Defeat The Pale Gardener in the Overgrown Citadel.|Craft a Gardener Invitation from Pale Blooms.

Quests.Title: The promise in the forge
Quests.Description: Find the Cinderwood landmark after Skeletron.|A Cinder Key opens this expedition.

Quests.Title: Beyond the shattered stars
Quests.Description: Find the Starglass landmark after Moon Lord.|Craft a Starglass Chart at the Ancient Manipulator.

Quests.Title: Noticeboard: circles of practice
Quests.Description: Activate a Ritual Focus and wait for its first pulse.|Do not stand still while enemies approach.

Quests.Title: Noticeboard: steam in the garden
Quests.Description: Combine Emberbloom and Tideglass on one enemy.|The first reaction opens more possibilities.

Scenes.Speaker: Lyra
Scenes.Text: I want the atelier to feel like a home I chose.|You know me as a trans woman, but there are so many|other things I want to make room for. Where do we begin?

Choices.Text: Find the pattern by the sea
Choices.Reply: Then let us follow the tide. I will be here.

Choices.Text: Make something that feels like you
Choices.Reply: That is a good beginning. The tide shrine has my old pattern.

Scenes.Speaker: Lyra
Scenes.Text: The stitches are imperfect. I think I like them that way.|This is a life of my own, not one someone chose for me.|Thank you for making room for that, {player}.

Choices.Text: There is room for your whole story
Choices.Reply: And for yours. Take this ribbon when the request is ready.

Scenes.Speaker: Archive echo
Scenes.Text: A line is missing from every ledger.|The caretaker still carries the torn pages.|Beyond it, something writes the travelers out of memory.

Choices.Reply: Find the caretaker. Its lantern moves where the halls go quiet.

Scenes.Speaker: Mira
Scenes.Text: A memorial need not be a warning.|It can be a garden, or a lantern someone keeps alight.|Would you help me make a gentler place?

Choices.Text: Let us start with a garden
Choices.Reply: A wreath first, then a light. Small things can hold a great deal.
